title: Chapter 412 - 412 Sincerity; Cooperation!
content:
Chapter 412 - 412 Sincerity; Cooperation!

Chapter 412 - 412 Sincerity; Cooperation!

412 Sincerity; Cooperation!

Wang Fugui sighed.

After a while, he slowly picked up his phone.

When he saw that the caller was Lin Fan, his expression did not change much.

A few days ago…

Wang Fugui was worried since Lin Fan had 20% of Yadi Automobile’s shares.

Now, he had temporarily thrown this matter to the back of his mind.

Compared to the shares, the super battery was more of an annoying matter to him.

After a while, Wang Fugui answered the call.

“Hello, Mr. Lin. What’s the matter?” Wang Fugui said in a tired tone.

“You should know about the super battery, right?”

When Wang Fugui heard this, his head hurt even more.

Was the major shareholder going to make things difficult for the company because of the incident with the superpower battery?

He was being thrown another problem before the first one was even settled!

Wang Fugui sighed again.

He forced himself to be alert. “From the data, the super battery is indeed very impressive. It can even be said to be epoch-making.

“If it’s used on new energy vehicles, it can reduce the dimensions of all the cars on the market today!

“However, the super battery hasn’t been invented yet.

“All employees of Yadi Automobile are actively preparing a response plan.

“Mr. Lin, don’t worry. Our Yadi Automobile will definitely be able to face the trouble that will arise.”

When Lin Fan heard this, a weird look appeared on his face.

A countermeasure?

Trouble?

Wang Fugui did not know that he was the one who wrote the research paper on super batteries?

After a while, Lin Fan said, “The super battery has been invented.”

“Huh?” Wang Fugui’s heart skipped a beat.

The invention of the super battery!

What should Yadi do?

“Mr. Lin, did you receive any news?” Wang Fugui asked hurriedly. “Could you please tell me where you learned about the matter?”

After all, Lin Fan was not an ordinary young man.

He was a super big shot who could buy 20% of Yadi Automobile’s shares.

It was normal for him to know some information!

Lin Fan said, “News? What news? I wrote the thesis that was published in Nature, and I invented the super battery. Come to Jiangbei, and I’ll sign some contracts for the cooperation with Yadi Automobile.”

Wang Fugui’s phone fell to the ground with a crisp sound.

Then, he quickly picked up his phone and said ‘hello’ several times, but no one responded.

Only then did he realize that the call had been hung up.

Wang Fugui could not help but mutter, “He wrote the thesis and invented the super battery… This, this…”

At this moment, there was a series of hurried knocks on the door.

“Come in!” Wang Fugui said.

Several directors walked in hurriedly with stacks of documents in their hands.

“We asked the technicians to re-simulate the data from The Principle and Use of Super Batteries. The data inside is without error. Chairman Wang…”

Wang Fugui did not wait for them to finish and interrupted, “Who’s the author of the thesis?”

The directors flipped through the information in their hands and said, “Lin Fan.”

“Lin Fan, Lin Fan, hahahaha!” Wang Fugui threw his head back and laughed. He was so happy that all his worries were swept away.

The directors at the side were puzzled.

“C-Chairman Wang, what’s wrong?”

Wang Fugui did not answer. Instead, he picked up his phone and said, “Secretary, help me buy a ticket to Jiangbei. Yes, the soonest flight!”

…

In the afternoon.

After Wang Fugui arrived at the airport, he made his way to the Coiling Dragon Villa without rest.

He calmed himself down and pressed the doorbell.

Lin Fan slowly opened the door and said, “Come in.”

Wang Fugui had seen Lin Fan’s photo and knew that he was very young.

However, when he saw him in person, he could not help but be shocked.

However, he quickly threw this thought to the back of his mind and hurriedly asked, “Mr. Lin, you just said on the phone that you invented the super battery?”

When he said that, Wang Fugui’s heart started to go crazy.

This matter was too important to him and the entire Yadi Automobile.

Lin Fan nodded. “Yeah, the patent has been applied for.”

After saying that, he turned on the tablet, which showed the electronic patent documents.

Seeing this…

Wang Fugui was so excited that he started trembling.

It was true!

The super battery was really invented!

Yadi Automobile was about to rise completely!

“What do you think?” Lin Fan asked.

Wang Fugui took a deep breath and suppressed his excitement. “If you give the super battery to our Yadi Automobile…

“Yadi Automobile can give you another 35% of the shares. In addition, 40% of the profits from the sales of the super batteries will belong to you.

“Mr. Lin, what do you think?”

Lin Fan already owned 20% of the shares of Yadi Automobile. Adding on 35% of shares, he would have a total of 55% shares. With more than half of the shares, he would become the largest shareholder of Yadi Automobile.

He even had the power to reject proposals!

There was also a 40% profit from the super battery!

It had to be said that Wang Fugui was sincere.

Lin Fan nodded and said, “Sure.”

As long as he was not the one managing the company, it did not matter.

When Wang Fugui heard this, he was overjoyed.

His biggest dream was to develop Yadi Automobile into the world’s top car company.

Now, this dream might be realized very soon!

Then, he borrowed the computer to hold a meeting with the shareholders and the top management.

Even though Wang Fugui was the chairman of Yadi Automobile, he was still just a member of the company.

Signing such a major contract still required the approval of the higher-ups and shareholders.

An intense debate and explanation ensued.

Two hours later, a contract that was freshly printed appeared in Lin Fan’s hands.

As usual, Lin Fan flipped through the pages quickly.

In less than ten seconds, he finished reading the thick contract.

Then, Lin Fan signed his name.

Wang Fugui, on the other hand, did not hesitate. He quickly stamped his official seal and signed his name.

He held the contract that was still warm, and the blood in his body seemed to boil.

After a while, Wang Fugui said, “Mr. Lin, I’ll go back to the company first.”

Even though the sky had already turned completely dark, he wanted to rush back to the company as soon as possible so that Yadi Automobile could be fully prepared for the next super-battery new energy vehicle.

Lin Fan yawned and said indifferently, “Alright.”
